posts.message: ⚠️ Confirmed: Network data show a significant decline in internet connectivity in #Venezuela including the capital Caracas following two 7+ magnitude back-to-back earthquakes that has impacted power and telecoms infrastructure.

⚠️ Nine hours after two 7+ magnitude earthquakes strike #Venezuela, national internet connectivity remains diminished despite some recovery. The outage corresponds to power cuts and infrastructure damage, hindering rescue efforts and limiting visibility into events on the ground.

⚠️ Update: Internet connectivity in #Venezuela remains below ordinary levels 24 hours following a devastating double earthquake event with impact to infrastructure still hampering rescue efforts, though the situation has improved with some partial restoration observed.

⚠️ Confirmed: Network data show a second collapse in internet connectivity in Sevastopol amid reports of unscheduled power shutdowns in occupied #Crimea as the regional Russian leadership declares a state of emergency.
⚠️ Confirmed: A power outage has knocked out internet connectivity in Donetsk Oblast, Russian-occupied eastern #Ukraine; the disruption corresponds to Ukrainian strikes on energy infrastructure 🔌
⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a decline in internet connectivity in occupied #Crimea corresponding to power outages after overnight Ukranian drone attacks targeting energy infrastructure 📉
⚠️ Confirmed: Internet outages have been registered in #Michigan including Detroit as severe storms bring down power and telecoms lines, leaving thousands of subscribers cut off 🔌 #MIwx

⚠️ Update: Metrics show internet connectivity in Pakistan-administered Azad Jammu and Kashmir remains heavily disrupted one month after a shutdown was imposed by authorities in anticipation of planned protests over the proscription of the JAAC group under anti-terrorism powers.
⚠️ Confirmed: Network data show rapidly diminishing internet connectivity levels in the US territory of #Guam corresponding to power outages as Super Typhoon Bavi strikes the Pacific islands
⚠️ Confirmed: Live metrics show that Sevastopol, occupied Crimea, is once again experiencing a near-total internet blackout amid escalating Ukrainian attacks on energy infrastructure.

⚠️ Confirmed: Analysis of network data indicates a significant decline in internet traffic in #Cuba corresponding to reports of a nation-wide power blackout. The incident comes as the island faces ongoing fuel shortages #apagón

⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show internet cuts corresponding to power outages in Sevastopol, occupied Crimea, intensifying amid Ukranian UAV attacks targeting energy infrastructure, with connectivity at 29% of ordinary levels as the regional Russian leadership imposes rolling blackouts

ℹ️ Note: Meta platforms including Instagram and Facebook are currently experiencing international outages; incident not related to country-level internet disruptions or filtering #InstagramDown #FacebookDown

⚠️Confirmed: Metrics show a disruption to internet service in #Kenya with national connectivity at 69% of ordinary levels; the incident corresponds to a widespread power outage affecting parts of the country including Nairobi 📉
⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a significant disruption to internet connectivity in Sumy, #Ukraine corresponding to power outages after overnight Russian attacks targeting energy infrastructure 📉
⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show a disruption to multiple social media platforms in Guinea corroborating user reports of difficulty accessing Facebook, YouTube and TikTok #Guinée

⚠️ Confirmed: Network data show that major internet provider TurkNet in #Turkey is currently experiencing a nation-scale outage, corroborating widespread user complaints; the company says engineers are working to restore service 📉

⚠️ Confirmed: Live metrics show a gradual decline in internet connectivity in Spokane County, Washington corresponding to evacuations and emergency power shutdowns in areas affected by the Old Trails Fire, a rapidly moving wildfire 🚒

⚠️ Confirmed: Analysis of network data indicates a significant decline in internet traffic in #Cuba corresponding to reports of a national power blackout. The incident comes amid continuing fuel shortages #apagón

⚠️ Confirmed: #Georgia has experienced the third in a series of nation-scale internet disruptions corresponding to power grid blackouts.

Authorities say today's incident was triggered by tests intended to diagnose Enguri HPP systems responsible for the earlier two outages.
